Hime's Quest.name: Hime's Quest
Hime's Quest.summary: It’s 1999, and something electric is in the air. A malevolent force has crept into New Crunchy City, wreaking havoc on its technology, and tragically destroying the Anime Club’s precious DVD/VCR combo player. Now Crunchyroll-Hime must travel through the haunted forest, rescue her friends, and fight these sinister villains if she’s to save the NCC Anime Club. Can you root out the dastardly cretin brazen enough to ruin their meeting—all before time runs out?

Saban's Power Rangers - Lightspeed Rescu.name: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
Saban's Power Rangers - Lightspeed Rescu.summary:
Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue is a video game based on the series of the same name which was released for the Game Boy Color.

The Game Boy Color version is a side-scrolling platformer. It features all five Rangers as playable characters and uses a password save system.
